Xavi Hernandez Appointed Netherlands Football Coach, First Foreigner in 48 Years

Xavi Hernandez, a celebrated figure from Spain's football history, has been appointed as the new head coach of the Netherlands national football team. This appointment marks a significant moment as he becomes the first foreign-born coach to lead the team since 1978, ending a 48-year streak of Dutch nationals in the role. Hernandez has reportedly signed a four-year deal. He expressed honor at being named coach, acknowledging the legacy of Dutch football.
